test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A tradesman marks his goods 25% above the cost price and allows his customers 12% reduction on their bills. What percentage profit does he make?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = 100 units

Marked Price (MP) = 25% above CP = 100 + 25 = 125 units

Discount = 12%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 - Discount%)

Profit% = [(SP - CP) / CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

MP = 125

Discount = 12%

SP = MP × (1 - Discount%)

⇒ SP = 125 × (1 - 12/100)

⇒ SP = 125 × 0.88

⇒ SP = 110

Profit = SP - CP

⇒ Profit = 110 - 100

⇒ Profit = 10

Profit% = (Profit / CP) × 100

⇒ Profit% = (10 / 100) × 100

⇒ Profit% = 10%

**The tradesman makes a profit of 10%. Correct option: 3.**
